⚡ Cache

Do Not Mark Clincoo HTML as Immutable

HTML cached forever holds back a new release. Use no-cache on the document, not on hashed assets.

This article is available in: Indonesia · English

On app.clincoo.buzz open the Network tab and reload the page. Read Cache-Control on the HTML document, not on the JS or CSS files.

HTML should be revalidated, for example with no-cache or a short max-age. Immutable is safe only for files whose names change when the contents change.

If HTML is immutable, visitors keep the old shell even after editor.clincoo.buzz has saved a new release.

Do not copy hashed-asset headers onto index.html. Split the document cache rule from the asset cache rule.

After you change the header, test in a private window. Ask AI to review the header only, and paste the response snippet, not the whole server config.
